Callout.Name: Cattle Theft in Progress
Callout.Message: Cattle being loaded at night onto a trailer.
Callout.Advisory: Two suspects, trailer backed up to the gate, no weapons seen.

Script.Line: There is a trailer at the field gate and they are loading it.
At half past two in the morning. That tells you everything.
Two of them, and one is watching the road.

Lines.Approach: They are loading cattle that are not theirs into a trailer in the dark. That is not a mistake.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
